persona.summary: A college student balancing a summer course, a research paper, part-time cafe work, and personal wellbeing.
persona.privacy: Synthetic and sanitized; no real person or institution is represented.

goals.title: Finish the summer term strongly
goals.description: Keep coursework moving without relying on deadline-week cramming.

goals.title: Maintain steady part-time income
goals.description: Complete scheduled cafe shifts while protecting study commitments.

goals.title: Protect health and energy
goals.description: Keep sleep, meals, movement, and recovery visible during a busy month.

items.title: Review sociology notes and prepare final questions
Finish presentation outline and evidence cards
Protect sleep, meals, and three movement sessions

daily_reflections.small_win: Finished the first week of readings before the weekend.
daily_reflections.mood_note: Tired after the Friday study block, but relieved.
daily_reflections.free_note: Morning study worked better than trying after a shift.

daily_reflections.small_win: Found two useful sources for the research paper.
daily_reflections.free_note: Keep source notes short and attach them to the outline.

daily_reflections.small_win: Handled a busy cafe shift without skipping lunch.
daily_reflections.free_note: Do not schedule demanding study immediately after Saturday work.

daily_reflections.small_win: Asked a question in class that clarified the final assignment.
daily_reflections.free_note: Turn the answer into one presentation evidence card.

daily_reflections.small_win: Returned to the paper after a distracted weekend.
daily_reflections.free_note: Use a 30-minute restart block when momentum is low.

daily_reflections.mood_note: Calm after seeing the whole argument on one page.
daily_reflections.free_note: Next week should be editing and practice, not more research.

daily_reflections.small_win: Protected the morning paper block before the cafe shift.
daily_reflections.free_note: The early block is the most reliable time for priority work.

daily_reflections.small_win: Practised the presentation once without reading the notes.
daily_reflections.free_note: Shorten the opening and keep the demo sequence fixed.
